sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.17 "EXTI software interrupt event register (EXTI_SWIER3)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1147.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x048
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register contains only bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:11 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 10:4 SWIx: Software interrupt on event x (x = 74 to 68)
0: Writing 0 has no effect.
1: Writing 1 to this bit triggers a rising edge event on event x (bit auto cleared by hardware).
l When SECx is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR3, SWIx can be accessed with non-secure
and secure access.
l When SECx is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR3, SWIx can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write to SWIx is discarded. Nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIVx is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR3, SWIx can be accessed with unprivileged
and privileged access.
l When PRIVx is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR3, SWIx can be accessed only with
privileged access. Unprivileged write to SWIx is discarded. Unprivileged read returns 0.
l A software interrupt is generated whatever the setting in EXTI_RTSR and EXTI_FTSR. It
always returns 0 when read.
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bit 2 SWI66: Software interrupt on event 66
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
